notes: NEW subject pack: Philosophy Basics — empiricism, rationalism, utilitarianism, deontology, virtue ethics, social contract, existentialism, and the mind-body problem, with which-idea, fallacy-spotting, and valid-or-invalid argument practice, never your assignment.

Detector V26 was trained and measured this run but HELD, not shipped: on the permanent frozen probe it caught 12 of 18 humanized texts, below the shipped V20's 13, so V20 stays live until a round genuinely beats it. The round did improve the false-flag rate to 4.53% (from V20's 4.71%), neural-paraphrase detection to 54.3% (from 51.1%), and GPT-5 detection to 92.6% (from 91.7%), and held the second probe at 11 of 12.
